info.title: Zoop API
info.description:
The Zoop tenant-scoped REST API.

All endpoints are scoped to a tenant and live under `/{tenantId}/api`. Authenticate with a bearer token — either a Supabase OAuth access token or a Zoop API key (prefixed `zoop_`). Each endpoint requires specific scopes; the required scope is noted in every operation's description.

This document is a point-in-time snapshot generated from the source route handlers; it is not hand-maintained.

delete.summary: Revoke the personal calendar feed token
delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:account`

Revokes the caller's currently active personal ICS calendar feed token for this tenant. Any calendar client subscribed with the previous feed URL will stop receiving updates. This operation is idempotent: if no active token exists, it still succeeds. Available to any tenant member (owner, office, or tech).

204.description: The active calendar feed token (if any) was revoked. No response body.

post.summary: Mint or rotate the personal calendar feed
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:account`

Mints a new personal ICS calendar feed token for the caller in this tenant, revoking any previously active token first. Returns the absolute, subscribable feed URL containing the raw token. The token is only shown once in this response and cannot be retrieved again; subscribe a calendar client (Apple Calendar, Google Calendar, Outlook) to the returned URL before leaving. Available to any tenant member (owner, office, or tech).

200.description: A new calendar feed token was minted. The response contains the absolute feed URL with the raw token embedded.

get.summary: Get busy intervals for a date range
get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:calendar`

Returns merged busy intervals (jobs, events, and — for owner/office only — pending holds) over the requested range. Tech callers never receive hold-derived intervals. `to` must be strictly after `from`.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601 datetime). Must be strictly after from.

parameters.name: assigneeIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of 1-50 assignee user UUIDs. Restricts intervals to those involving at least one listed assignee (intervals that block everyone are always retained).

post.summary: Create a calendar event (one-off or recurring)
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:calendar`

Creates a one-off calendar event, or — when `recurrence` is supplied — a recurring event series whose rolling 90-day window is materialized synchronously. A tech caller may only create event kinds permitted by the tenant's `tech_can_create_event_kinds` setting; other kinds return 403.

201.description: Event (or series) created. One-off returns event_id; recurring returns series_id and the number of materialized instances.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:calendar`

Returns one event with its assignees and, when the event belongs to a series, the series' recurrence (rrule, timezone, duration_min) for the edit modal.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:calendar`

Owner or office only (techs receive 403). Edits an event using one of three modes: `this` (this occurrence only), `this_and_future` (caps the series and creates a new series from the occurrence onward), or `all` (edits the whole series template). For `this` and `this_and_future`, `occurrence_date` is required. Non-recurring events accept only `mode=this`. Response shape varies by mode: `this` returns the updated event row; `all` and `this_and_future` return `{ series_id }`.

200.description: Event updated. For mode=this, the updated calendar event row; for mode=all and mode=this_and_future, the (possibly new) series id.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:calendar`

Owner or office only (techs receive 403). Cancels via the `mode` query param: `this` (this occurrence), `this_and_future` (caps the series and cancels future scheduled occurrences), or `all` (cancels the entire series). Non-recurring events accept only `mode=this`. Rows are soft-cancelled (status set to `cancelled`), preserved for history.

post.summary: Respond to your own event invitation
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:calendar`

The caller updates their own assignee response (`accepted` or `declined`) for the event. Only the caller's own assignee row is affected. Returns 404 (same shape for cross-tenant events) when the caller is not an assignee of this event in this tenant.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:calendar`

Owner or office only (techs receive 403). Returns `booking_holds` rows for the dispatcher's holds inbox, filtered by status (default `pending`) and optionally by a `requested_start` window. Pending holds are sorted by soonest expiration; other statuses by most-recent activity. Returns full guest contact info for the tenant.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Hold status to list. Defaults to pending.

post.summary: Confirm a booking hold (promote to a job)
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:calendar`

Owner or office only (techs receive 403). Atomically promotes a pending hold to a `jobs` row at the customer's requested slot, via the `confirm_booking_hold` RPC. Returns 409 when the hold is no longer pending, 404 when the hold (or referenced crew) is not found, and 400 for payload/business validation errors (e.g. crew tenant mismatch, assigned user not a member).

200.description: Hold confirmed and promoted to a job.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:calendar`

Owner or office only (techs receive 403). Releases a pending hold with a reason and notifies the requestor (email, plus best-effort SMS). Returns 400 when the hold is not pending, and 404 when the hold is not found in this tenant (same shape for cross-tenant holds).

post.summary: Propose an alternate slot for a booking hold
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:calendar`

Owner or office only (techs receive 403). Shifts the hold's requested window to a proposed slot, extends `expires_at` by the tenant's hold TTL, mints a one-shot acceptance token, and emails the customer a tokenized accept link. The hold stays `pending`. The slot cannot exceed 8 hours and `requested_end` must be after `requested_start`. Returns 409 when the hold is not pending. Email send failures are best-effort and do not fail the request.

200.description: Hold window updated and suggestion email dispatched.

get.summary: Fetch calendar grid items for a date range
get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:calendar`

Returns the three calendar row sources (jobs, events, holds) in one round-trip for the calendar grid. RLS scopes rows per role: a tech sees only their own jobs and events and zero holds; owner/office see everything in the tenant. The `from`/`to` window is required and `to` must be strictly after `from`. Holds are returned only for owner/office (empty array for techs).

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: End of the range (ISO 8601 datetime). Must be strictly after from.

parameters.name: assigneeIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of 1-50 assignee user UUIDs. Filters jobs/events to those involving at least one of these users.

parameters.name: crewIds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of 1-20 crew UUIDs (ZOO-480). Expanded to member user_ids and unioned with assigneeIds before filtering.

parameters.name: kinds
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of 1-4 event kinds (meeting, block, personal, other). Applied to calendar events only; jobs are never filtered by this param.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

Owner or office only (techs receive 403). Narrow calendar verb for moving a job to a new slot. Setting `scheduled_start` to null unschedules the job (forces status `unscheduled` and clears `scheduled_end`); a non-null start sets status `scheduled`. `scheduled_end`, when present alongside a start, must be strictly after `scheduled_start`. Returns the updated job row.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:catalog_categories`

Returns all catalog categories for the tenant, ordered by `sort_order` ascending then `name` ascending. By default the response is a flat array of categories. When `tree=true` is supplied, the response is a nested tree where each category carries a `children` array (categories whose `parent_id` is not present in the result set are placed at the top level).

parameters.name: tree
parameters.description: When set to the literal string `true`, returns a nested tree of CatalogCategoryNode objects instead of a flat array.

200.description: A flat list of catalog categories, or a nested tree when `tree=true`.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:catalog_categories`

Creates a new catalog category. Restricted to tenant members with the `owner` role; other roles receive `403 Forbidden`. Returns `409 Conflict` when a category with the same name already exists under the same parent.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the catalog category.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:catalog_categories`

Updates an existing catalog category. Restricted to tenant members with the `owner` role; other roles receive `403 Forbidden`. Returns `409 Conflict` if the change would introduce a cycle in the category hierarchy (`category_cycle`), or if a category with the same name already exists under the same parent. Returns `404 Not Found` if the category does not exist for the tenant.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:catalog_categories`

Deletes a catalog category. Restricted to tenant members with the `owner` role; other roles receive `403 Forbidden`. The deletion is atomic: child categories are re-parented and the category is deleted in a single transaction. Any catalog items referencing the category have their `category_id` cleared automatically. Returns `404 Not Found` if the category does not exist for the tenant.

204.description: The catalog category was deleted successfully.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:catalog_items`

List and search the tenant's catalog items. Each item is returned in a role-appropriate shape: only `owner` callers see cost/markup/supplier fields; `office` and `tech` callers receive the public shape with those fields stripped. Bundle items include their joined `components`. Supports filtering by `kind`, `category_id` (optionally expanded to descendant categories via `include_descendants`), active/archived status, free-text search (`q`), and cursor pagination.

parameters.name: category_id
parameters.description: Filter to items in this category.

parameters.name: include_descendants
parameters.description: When `true` and `category_id` is supplied, also include items in descendant categories.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: When `true`, return only non-archived items; when `false`, return only archived items. Omit to return both.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, min 1, max 200).

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:catalog_items`

Restricted to the `owner` role — other roles receive 403. Create a catalog item. The request body is a discriminated union on `kind`; `bundle` items require a non-empty `components` array and `discount` items require `discount_type`. If `category_id` is supplied it must belong to this tenant, otherwise a 422 `invalid_category` error is returned. Returns the created item in the owner shape.

422.description: The supplied `category_id` does not belong to this tenant (`invalid_category`).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:catalog_items`

Fetch a single non-archived catalog item in a role-appropriate shape (only `owner` callers see cost/markup/supplier fields). For `bundle` items, each entry in `components` is enriched with the fully serialized referenced catalog `item` (or null if unavailable).

200.description: The catalog item. For bundles, `components` entries carry a nested serialized `item`.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:catalog_items`

Restricted to the `owner` role — other roles receive 403. Partially update a catalog item; all fields are optional. If `discount_value` is supplied, `discount_type` must accompany it. For `bundle` items, supplying `components` atomically replaces the bundle's component set. If `category_id` is supplied it must belong to this tenant, otherwise a 422 `invalid_category` error is returned. Returns the updated item in the owner shape.

422.description: The supplied `category_id` does not belong to this tenant (`invalid_category`).

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:catalog_items`

Restricted to the `owner` role — other roles receive 403. Soft-deletes (archives) the catalog item. If the item is referenced by one or more active (non-archived) bundles, the request is rejected with a 409 `bundle_component_conflict` and the item is not archived. Returns 204 No Content on success.

204.description: The catalog item was archived. No content is returned.

patch.summary: Associate a communication with a customer
patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:communications`

Link a communication (typically an unassociated inbound message) to a customer, optionally also setting a contact. The target customer must exist in this tenant and not be soft-deleted (404 otherwise). The communication must exist in this tenant (404 otherwise). Passing no `contact_id` clears any existing contact association.

200.description: The updated communication, now linked to the customer.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:communications`

Send an email to a customer on behalf of the tenant via the configured email provider (Resend). The recipient is resolved from the customer's contacts: if `contact_id` is supplied that contact is used, otherwise the customer's primary contact is used; the resolved contact must have an email address (409 if it does not). Sends are deduplicated by `idempotency_key` (scoped to outbound email): a repeat call with a previously-seen key returns the existing communication with HTTP 200 instead of creating a new one. `subject_type` and `subject_id` must be supplied together or omitted together.

200.description: Duplicate request — a communication with the same `idempotency_key` already existed; the existing communication is returned unchanged.

201.description: The email was accepted and a new outbound communication row was created (status `queued`/`sending`).

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:communications`

Send an SMS to a customer on behalf of the tenant via the configured SMS provider (Twilio). The recipient is resolved from the customer's contacts: if `contact_id` is supplied that contact is used, otherwise the customer's primary contact is used. The resolved contact must have a phone number (409 if it does not) and must be SMS-enabled — a contact opted out of SMS (`phone_can_sms` false) yields 409. Sends are deduplicated by `idempotency_key` (scoped to outbound SMS): a repeat call with a previously-seen key returns the existing communication with HTTP 200 instead of creating a new one. `subject_type` and `subject_id` must be supplied together or omitted together.

200.description: Duplicate request — a communication with the same `idempotency_key` already existed; the existing communication is returned unchanged.

201.description: The SMS was accepted and a new outbound communication row was created (status `queued`/`sending`).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:communications`

List inbound communications that have not yet been linked to a customer (`direction` is `inbound` and `customer_id` is null), most recent first. Use these to triage messages that could not be auto-correlated to a customer, then attach them with the associate-customer endpoint. Pagination is keyed on `created_at`: pass the previous page's `next_cursor` as `cursor` to fetch older rows.

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only include communications created at or after this ISO-8601 datetime (inclusive lower bound).

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor — the `created_at` value (ISO-8601 datetime) of the last row from the previous page; returns rows created strictly before it. Taken from the previous response's `next_cursor`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of communications to return (default 50, min 1, max 100).

200.description: A page of unassociated inbound communications.

next_cursor.description: The `created_at` of the last row in this page, to be passed as `cursor` for the next page; null when there are no more results.

get.summary: List companies the caller belongs to
get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:companies`

Returns every company (tenant) the authenticated user is a member of, including the caller's role in each. The caller must be a member of the tenant identified by the URL `{tenantId}` (the active context is validated).

200.description: Array of companies the caller is a member of.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:companies`

Creates a new company (tenant) and makes the authenticated user its owner. A default `company_settings` row is auto-provisioned. The caller must be a member of the tenant identified by the URL `{tenantId}` (the active context is validated).

201.description: The created company. `slug` and `logo_url` default to null and `plan` defaults to `free`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:companies`

Returns the company (tenant) identified by the URL `{tenantId}`. The caller must be a member of that tenant.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:companies`

Updates the company (tenant) identified by the URL `{tenantId}`. **Owner role required** — non-owner members receive 403. A partial update: every field is optional but at least one of `name`, `slug`, or `published` must be supplied. `slug` is normalized to lowercase and validated against the storefront slug shape and reserved-slug denylist. `published: true` marks the storefront live; `false` takes it offline.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:settings`

Lists crews for the tenant. Owner and office callers see all crews; tech callers see only crews they belong to (enforced by row-level security). Archived crews are excluded by default; pass `archived=true` to include them. Each crew includes a derived `member_count`; the full member list is returned by the single-crew endpoint, not here.

parameters.name: archived
parameters.description: When `true`, include archived crews. Defaults to excluding archived crews. Must be exactly `"true"` or `"false"`.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Restricted to owner and office roles. Creates a crew with the given name. The name is trimmed and must be 1–80 characters after trimming. A name that collides with an existing active (non-archived) crew name in the tenant returns 409. The created crew is returned with `member_count` equal to 0.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:settings`

Returns a single crew including its members. Any tenant member may call this; row-level security determines visibility. Tech callers see only crews they belong to; owner and office see all. A crew that does not exist (or is not visible to the caller) returns 404.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Restricted to owner and office roles. Renames and/or archives a crew. At least one of `name` or `archive` must be supplied. `archive: true` sets the archived state; `archive: false` clears it (unarchive). A rename that collides with an existing active crew name returns 409. If the request results in no change, the current crew is returned with `changed: false` and no audit event is emitted.

200.description: The updated crew. `changed` indicates whether any field actually changed.

changed.description: False when the request was a no-op (no fields changed).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:settings`

Lists the members of a crew, ordered by when they were added (ascending). Visibility is gated by row-level security: owner and office see the full roster; tech callers see the roster only for crews they themselves belong to. A crew that does not exist (or is not visible) returns 404.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Restricted to owner and office roles. Adds a user to a crew. The target `user_id` must already be a member of the tenant; otherwise a 400 is returned with the error code `user_not_in_tenant`. Re-adding an existing member returns 409. A crew that does not exist (or is not visible) returns 404.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: Identifier of the user to remove from the crew.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Restricted to owner and office roles. Removes a user from a crew. The operation is idempotent: removing a membership that does not exist returns 200 with `removed: false`. A crew that does not exist (or is not visible) in the tenant returns 404. Note: this endpoint returns 200 with a body rather than 204.

200.description: Removal result. `removed` is true only when a membership row was actually deleted.

removed.description: True when a membership was deleted; false when no matching membership existed (idempotent no-op).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

List and search customers for the tenant. Supports free-text search (`q`, capped at 256 characters), status/type filters, tag filter, and cursor pagination. The `has_open_balance` and `has_open_jobs` filters are not yet supported and return 400 if supplied. Rate-limited to 60 requests/minute per user.

200.description: A page of customer search results.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Create an individual or company customer. The request body is a discriminated union on `customer_type`. Returns 409 if a customer with the same phone number already exists.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Fetch a single customer with its live (non-deleted) contacts and locations. If the requested customer was merged into a survivor record, the response is a `{ "merged_into": "<survivor-id>" }` redirect pointer instead of the full customer object.

200.description: The customer with its contacts and locations, or a merge-redirect pointer.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Update editable customer fields. Lifecycle fields (`status`, `deleted_at`, `archived_at`, `merged_into_customer_id`) are rejected with a 400 `disallowed_fields` error — use the dedicated archive/restore/merge routes instead.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Soft-archives the customer (same lifecycle action as `POST /customers/{id}/archive`). Owner role only.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Soft-archives (soft-deletes) the customer. Owner role only.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

List all file attachments for the customer, newest first.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Upload a file attachment via `multipart/form-data`. The upload is validated for size, MIME type, and filename safety before storage. Form fields: `file` (required), `attachment_type` (optional, defaults to `other`), and `label` (optional, defaults to the sanitized filename).

label.description: Human-readable label. Defaults to the sanitized filename.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Returns a short-lived (5-minute TTL) signed download URL for the attachment.

url.description: Signed download URL valid for 5 minutes.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Deletes the attachment record and its underlying stored object.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Fetch the customer's billing profile (payment terms, tax settings, billing preferences).

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Update billing-policy fields (payment terms, tax rate/exemption, invoice and reminder preferences, billing contact).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

List all contacts for the customer.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Create a contact for the customer. The phone number, if provided, is normalized to E.164. Returns 409 if attempting to add a second primary contact.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Fetch a single contact for the customer.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Partially update a contact. Unknown keys are ignored. Mutations are rejected with 404 if the parent customer is archived. Phone numbers are normalized to E.164.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Archives (soft-deletes) the contact. Rejected with 404 if the parent customer is archived.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Atomically demotes the current primary contact and promotes the specified contact to primary. The primary contact's number/email receives SMS and billing communications for the customer.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Returns potential duplicate customer records for the given customer, for use in merge workflows.

candidates.description: Potential duplicate customer records. Exact item shape is determined by findDuplicateCandidates and not fully resolved here.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

List all service locations for the customer.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Create a service location for the customer. Returns 409 if attempting to add a second primary location.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Fetch a single service location for the customer.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Partially update a service location. Unknown keys are ignored. Mutations are rejected with 404 if the parent customer is archived. Returns 409 when flipping `is_primary` would create a second primary location of the same type.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Archives (soft-deletes) the service location. Rejected with 404 if the parent customer is archived.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Owner role only. Mints a fresh customer portal token, atomically revoking any prior active token (one active token per customer). The plaintext token and public account URL are returned exactly once and cannot be re-fetched.

201.description: The newly minted portal token (returned once).

token.description: The plaintext portal token. Returned only once.

url.description: Public account URL containing the token.

created_at.description: When the token row was created.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Owner role only. Revokes the customer's active portal token. No-op (still 204) when no active token exists.

204.description: Token revoked (or no active token to revoke).

post.summary: Assign a tag to a customer
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Assigns a tag to the customer. Idempotent — re-assigning an existing tag is a no-op. Returns 200 with no body on success.

delete.summary: Remove a tag from a customer
delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Removes a tag assignment from the customer.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Returns the customer's communication timeline, with optional filtering by channel, direction, subject, and time range, plus cursor pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of entries to return (1-100).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only include entries at or after this timestamp.

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only include entries at or before this timestamp.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more entries.

post.summary: Find or create a customer by phone
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Looks up a live customer by normalized (E.164) phone number; creates one if none exists. The body is a discriminated union on `customer_type`. Rate-limited per actor (30/min) and per tenant (200/min).

**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Merges a duplicate (merged) customer into a survivor record. This is irreversible. Returns 422 for invalid merge requests (e.g. merging a customer into itself), 404 if either customer is missing, and 409 if the merged record was already merged elsewhere.

422.description: The merge request was understood but cannot be processed (e.g. cannot merge a customer into itself, or invalid primary-contact resolution).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:credentials`

List this tenant's active (non-revoked) API keys, newest first. Owner-only: callers whose tenant membership role is not `owner` receive `403`. The plaintext key value is NEVER returned by this endpoint — only the `key_prefix` (a short non-secret identifier) is included. The full secret is shown exactly once, at creation time. The result is capped at 200 rows.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:credentials`

Create a new external API key for this tenant. Owner-only: callers whose tenant membership role is not `owner` receive `403`. Granting admin-tier scopes (`admin:tenant`, `admin:billing`, `admin:credentials`) is restricted to owners; a non-owner requesting any admin scope is rejected with `403`. If `expires_at` is supplied it must be an ISO 8601 datetime in the future, otherwise `400` is returned. Issuance is rate-limited per actor and per tenant; exceeding either limit returns `429` with a `Retry-After` header.

The response contains the plaintext key in the `key` field. This is the ONLY time the full secret is ever returned — it is hashed at rest and cannot be retrieved again. Store it securely on receipt.

201.description: The created API key, including the plaintext `key` shown only once.

parameters.name: keyId
parameters.description: Id of the API key to revoke.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:credentials`

Revoke (permanently disable) an API key by id. Owner-only: callers whose tenant membership role is not `owner` receive `403`. The `keyId` must be a valid UUID, otherwise `400` is returned. Returns `204 No Content` on success. If no matching active key is found for this tenant — wrong tenant, unknown id, or already revoked — the endpoint returns `404`. Revocation is irreversible.

204.description: The API key was revoked. No response body.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:invoices`

List invoices for the tenant, newest first. Uses offset pagination (`page`, fixed page size of 20). When no `status` filter is supplied, voided invoices are excluded. The `status` filter only accepts the five user-facing lifecycle statuses (`draft`, `sent`, `paid`, `overdue`, `void`); any other value returns 400.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Must be a positive integer (defaults to 1). Page size is fixed at 20.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter by lifecycle status. When omitted, voided invoices are excluded from results.

count.description: Total number of matching invoices across all pages (exact count).

page.description: The page number that was returned.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:invoices`

Owner role only. Create a draft invoice. There are three creation modes: (1) a fully specified invoice with `customer_id` and optional `line_items` (totals/tax computed server-side); (2) `from_quote_id` to derive the invoice atomically from a quote; or (3) `from_job_id` to derive it from a job. When a `from_*` shortcut is used, `customer_id`/`quote_id`/`job_id`/`line_items` must not be supplied — they are derived from the source row. Returns 404 if a referenced quote/job is not found, and 409 if the source quote is archived.

201.description: The created invoice. Includes all persisted columns plus a duplicate `invoice_id` field. If the post-create re-fetch fails, only `{ id, invoice_id }` is returned.

invoice_id.description: Duplicate of `id`, included for client convenience.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:invoices`

Fetch a single invoice with its embedded customer, quote, and job summaries.

200.description: The invoice with embedded customer / quote / job relations.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:invoices`

Owner role only. Update an invoice. Two modes: a scalar update (status / dates / notes / total) and an editor update (`line_items` supplied — totals and tax are recomputed server-side and line items replaced wholesale). Non-status fields can only be edited while the invoice is in `draft` status; supplying any non-status field on a non-draft invoice returns 409. Status-only transitions are permitted on non-draft invoices.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:invoices`

Owner role only. Soft-deletes the invoice by setting its status to `void`. Voiding preserves all billing history (past payments stay attached as facts); it is not a hard delete.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:invoices`

Owner role only. First-time send of a draft invoice. Flips the invoice to `sent` (sets `issued_at` / `finalized_at`, and mints a `public_token` if one does not exist), then enqueues the email/SMS dispatch. Requires the invoice to be in `draft` status (409 otherwise — use send-reminder for subsequent sends) and the customer to have an email or SMS-capable phone (422 otherwise). Takes no request body. Returns the planned delivery list.

200.description: The invoice was marked sent and dispatch was enqueued. Returns the planned deliveries.

422.description: The customer has no email or SMS-capable phone to deliver to.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:invoices`

Owner role only. Re-sends an already-sent invoice without changing its status. Allowed only when the invoice is in `sent` or `overdue` status (409 otherwise). Requires the customer to have an email or SMS-capable phone (422 otherwise). Takes no request body. Returns the planned delivery list. Returns 503 if the dispatch could not be enqueued.

200.description: A reminder dispatch was enqueued. Returns the planned deliveries.

422.description: The customer has no email or SMS-capable phone to deliver to.

503.description: The reminder dispatch could not be queued.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:job_series`

Creates a recurring job series template and synchronously materializes the first rolling window of job instances. Validates that every entry in `assigned_user_ids` is a member of the tenant (returns 400 if any are not). The RRULE is restricted to FREQ of DAILY, WEEKLY, MONTHLY, or YEARLY; sub-daily expansion tokens (BYHOUR, BYMINUTE, BYSECOND) are rejected, COUNT must be 1-366, and UNTIL must be within 1825 days of now.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:job_series`

Returns a single job series with its line items, assigned users, customer summary, and up to 20 upcoming job instances ordered by scheduled start.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:job_series`

Updates a job series using one of two edit modes. With `mode=all`, the series row is patched in place and all future unscheduled/scheduled instances are regenerated (done/cancelled instances are preserved). With `mode=this_and_future`, the original series is capped the day before `occurrence_date` (which is required for this mode), future unscheduled/scheduled instances on or after that date are deleted, and a new series is created starting at `occurrence_date` with the patched values — the response is the newly created split series. Only the fields provided are changed; omitted fields are left unchanged (or copied from the original for the split case).

200.description: The updated job series (for `mode=all`) or the newly created split series (for `mode=this_and_future`).

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:job_series`

Cancels the entire series by setting its `ends_on` to today and bulk-cancelling all future unscheduled/scheduled instances (instances with status `done` or `cancelled` are left intact as historical record). Returns no content.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:jobs`

List and filter jobs for the tenant. Supports filtering by status, customer, series, a scheduled-start date window (`from`/`to`), and a free-text title search (`q`). Results are page-numbered (20 per page), ordered by `scheduled_start` ascending (nulls last) then `created_at` descending.

Note: this list uses page-number pagination (`page` query param) and returns `{ data, count, page, limit }` — it does not use the cursor/`next_cursor` envelope used elsewhere in the API.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text, case-insensitive substring match on the job title.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

Create a one-time job. If `scheduled_start` is supplied the job is created with status `scheduled`, otherwise `unscheduled`. Line items and crew assignments are created atomically (a failure rolls the job back). Every id in `assigned_user_ids` must belong to a member of this tenant, otherwise the request fails with 400.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:jobs`

Fetch a single job with its line items, crew assignments, an inline preview of up to 50 media items, and a thin customer summary. A non-UUID `id` returns 404 without touching the database. Use `GET /jobs/{id}/media` for the authoritative, signed-URL media list.

200.description: The job with its related line items, assignments, media preview, and customer summary.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

Partially update a job. Any omitted field is left unchanged. Setting `status` to `done` stamps `completed_at`; setting it to any other value clears `completed_at`. When `line_items` or `assigned_user_ids` are supplied they fully replace the existing rows.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

Delete a job. Only jobs in status `unscheduled` or `cancelled` can be deleted; deleting a `scheduled` or `done` job returns 409.

post.summary: Assign a crew to a job
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

**Role restriction:** caller must have the `owner` or `office` role; `tech` callers receive 403.

Assigns every member of a crew to the job as individual assignments, deduping against any pre-existing assignments. Returns the inserted-vs-member counts so the caller can distinguish "newly added" from "already assigned". A non-UUID `id` returns 404; a crew belonging to another tenant returns 400.

**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

Transition a job from `scheduled` or `unscheduled` to `done`, stamping `completed_at`. Idempotent: completing an already-`done` job returns 200 with the original row and never overwrites the original `completed_at`. A job in any other state returns 409 (`invalid_state_transition`). This request takes no body.

200.description: The completed job row (or, idempotently, the already-completed row).

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

Upload a single photo or video attachment to a job as `multipart/form-data`. The file is size-capped at 50 MB and restricted to an image/short-video MIME allowlist (`image/jpeg`, `image/png`, `image/webp`, `image/gif`, `image/heic`, `image/heif`, `video/mp4`, `video/quicktime`). The declared `kind` must agree with the file's top-level MIME type (`photo`→image, `video`→video) or the request fails with 400. A rejected upload returns 400, 413, or 415 depending on the reason. The response includes a 1-hour signed URL.

file.contentType: image/jpeg, image/png, image/webp, image/gif, image/heic, image/heif, video/mp4, video/quicktime

201.description: The recorded media row, including a temporary signed URL.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

Delete a single media item attached to a job. Removes both the database row and the stored object. Returns 404 if the media item does not belong to the given job within this tenant.

parameters.name: estimateId
parameters.description: The source quote id. Named `estimateId` for backwards compatibility — quote and estimate ids are interchangeable for records that predate the rename.

post.summary: Create a job from a quote (deprecated estimate URL)
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:jobs`

**Deprecated.** This is the legacy `from-estimate` URL retained during the rename of estimates to quotes; it forwards the request body verbatim to the quote-conversion handler and is scheduled for removal. Prefer the quote-conversion endpoint.

Converts a quote into work. With no `recurrence`, creates a single job (status `scheduled` when `scheduled_start` is supplied, otherwise `unscheduled`) and returns the job row. With `recurrence`, creates a recurring `job_series`, materializes the first window, and returns a series summary. Line items are copied from the quote. `scheduled_start` and `recurrence` are mutually exclusive. Every id in `assigned_user_ids` must be a member of this tenant.

201.description: Either the created one-time job, or a recurring-series summary.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:notes`

List notes for the tenant. Supports filtering by subject (`subject_type` + `subject_id`, or the `standalone` sentinel for notes with no subject), pinned state, author, agent, and a created-at time window (`since`/`until`). When a free-text query (`q`, max 256 characters) is supplied, results are ranked by full-text + trigram search; in that mode `next_cursor` is always null and `has_more` is the only continuation signal. The `standalone` subject filter cannot be combined with `subject_id` or with `q` (returns 400). Draft notes (photo-first flow) are excluded.

parameters.name: subject_type
parameters.description: Filter by subject type. The `standalone` sentinel matches notes with no attached subject (cannot be combined with `subject_id` or `q`).

parameters.name: subject_id
parameters.description: Filter by the id of the attached subject.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search query (max 256 characters). Enables ranked search mode.

parameters.name: pinned
parameters.description: Filter by pinned state. Pass `true` or `false`.

parameters.name: author
parameters.description: Filter by the id of the user that created the note (`created_by`).

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Filter by the agent that created the note (`created_by_agent`).

parameters.name: since
parameters.description: Only include notes created at or after this ISO-8601 datetime (inclusive lower bound).

parameters.name: until
parameters.description: Only include notes created strictly before this ISO-8601 datetime (exclusive upper bound).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of notes to return (default 25, min 1, max 100).

200.description: A page of notes. Each note is enriched with its signed photo attachments.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, or null when there are no more results. Always null in search mode (`q` supplied) — use `has_more` instead.

has_more.description: True when more results exist beyond this page. In search mode this may be true while `next_cursor` is null, signalling truncation (refine the query).

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:notes`

Create a note. A note may be standalone (omit both `subject_type` and `subject_id`) or attached to a subject (supply both). Attaching a subject that does not exist in this tenant returns 404. The body may only be empty when `draft` is true (photo-first flow). Rate-limited per user (shared write bucket across create, update, and version-restore).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:notes`

Fetch a single non-deleted note by id.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:notes`

Update a note's body, pinned state, or attached subject, or commit a draft (`draft: false`). At least one field must be supplied. Subject fields are "both or neither": send both `subject_type` and `subject_id` (both non-null to attach, both null to detach). Attaching a subject that does not exist in this tenant returns 404.

Only the note's author or a tenant owner may update it; other tenant members receive 403. Rate-limited per user (shared write bucket across create, update, and version-restore).

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:notes`

Soft-delete a note. Only the note's author or a tenant owner may delete it; other tenant members receive 403.

204.description: The note was soft-deleted. No content.

post.summary: Create or resume Stripe Connect onboarding
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:payments`

Creates a Stripe Connect Express account for the tenant (if one doesn't already exist), upserts the local processor config row, then returns a fresh Stripe-hosted onboarding URL. The browser navigates to that URL; Stripe returns to the tenant's payment settings return page when KYC is submitted (or when the link expires).

A previously `disconnected` account is treated as fresh-start intent: a new Stripe account is minted rather than reusing the dead account id. The authenticated user must have an email on file (used to seed the Express account).

502.description: The Stripe processor call failed (could not start onboarding).

post.summary: Mint a Stripe Express dashboard login link
post.description:
**Required scope:** `read:payments`

Mints a single-use, short-lived Stripe Express dashboard login URL for the tenant's Connect account. The frontend opens it in a new tab; the link is not cached. Requires a Stripe account already on file (404 otherwise).

502.description: Could not reach Stripe to mint the dashboard link.

post.summary: Disconnect the tenant's Stripe Connect account
post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:payments`

Marks the tenant's Stripe processor row as `disconnected`, clears the capability flags (`charges_enabled` / `payouts_enabled`), and stops the UI from offering Stripe-backed actions. The Stripe account id is preserved on the row for audit / re-connect history. No Stripe API call is made (Express accounts cannot be deauthorized via API). Requires a Stripe processor row already on file (404 otherwise).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `write:payments`

Re-fetches the tenant's Stripe Connect account from Stripe and writes the latest capability flags and requirements onto the local processor config. Called by the return handler after Stripe redirects the merchant back from onboarding, and from any "Resume setup" / "Refresh status" UI control. Idempotent; safe to call repeatedly.

Note: despite mutating local state, this is exposed as a GET (invoked on a redirect-back navigation). Requires a Stripe account already on file (404 otherwise).

200.description: Latest derived status and capability flags.

502.description: Could not reach Stripe to retrieve account status.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:payments`

Updates the authenticated tenant's offline payment instructions. The value is surfaced to customers on invoices when they choose not to pay online (e.g. "Mail check to PO Box 123, Austin TX"). Passing `null` — or a whitespace-only string — clears the field so the customer-facing UI suppresses the section entirely. The value is trimmed server-side before persisting.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:plans`

Returns the tenant's recurring plans, newest first (ordered by `created_at` descending). Each plan embeds a minimal `customer` object (`id`, `display_name`). This endpoint is not paginated: it returns every plan for the tenant in a single response under the `data` key.

data.description: The tenant's recurring plans, each with an embedded `customer` summary.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:plans`

Creates a recurring plan template plus its line items (at least one item is required). The plan and its items are written sequentially; if the item insert fails the plan row is rolled back so no header is ever left without items.

`next_invoice_at` is always computed server-side from `cadence_rrule` and `start_date` (defaulting to now) — any client-supplied value is ignored. The new plan starts with status `active`.

Auto-charge is gated server-side: even if `auto_charge_enabled` is sent as `true`, it is forced to `false` unless an active `auto_pay_recurring` payment consent already exists for the customer. An invalid RRULE returns 400.

201.description: The created plan row. The response also includes a `plan_id` field mirroring `id`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:plans`

Returns a single recurring plan template plus its line items (in sort order) and an embedded `customer` summary. Returns 404 if the plan does not exist within the caller's tenant.

200.description: The recurring plan, with embedded `customer` and `items`.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:plans`

Updates the plan template only; previously generated invoices are never retroactively mutated. Every field is optional — only fields present in the body are touched. Unknown keys (including `customer_id`, which cannot be changed) are rejected with 400.

If `items` is supplied it must contain at least one entry; an empty/zero-item result is rejected with 400. The scalar update and item replacement run as a single atomic RPC.

If `cadence_rrule` changes, `next_invoice_at` is recomputed from now (an invalid RRULE returns 400). Enabling `auto_charge_enabled` is re-verified against an active `auto_pay_recurring` consent and silently forced to `false` if none exists.

200.description: The updated plan, with embedded `customer` and `items`.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:quotes`

List non-archived quotes for the tenant, newest first. Any tenant member (owner, office, or tech) may read. Uses page-based pagination: pass `page` (1-based); the page size is fixed at 20. Quotes with `status` `archived` are excluded.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: 1-based page number. Values below 1 are clamped to 1. Page size is fixed at 20.

count.description: Total number of non-archived quotes matching the query.

page.description: The page number that was returned.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:quotes`

Create a new quote. Restricted to the `owner` role (office/tech may read but not author quotes). The quote is created in `draft` status. Optionally include a one-shot `tool_input` (lawn measurement) to create the quote shell and its lawn measurement together; if the embedded tool-input write fails, the quote is rolled back.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:quotes`

Fetch a single quote with its embedded line items, tool inputs, sections (sorted by `sort_order`), and attachments. Any tenant member may read. Each attachment is enriched with a fresh signed URL (valid 1 hour); if signing fails for an individual attachment, that attachment carries `signed_url: null` and `signed_url_error: "storage_unavailable"` while the rest of the quote still renders.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:quotes`

Update a quote's scalar fields, line items, sections, and/or lawn tool input in a single atomic transaction. Restricted to the `owner` role. Only the keys supplied are changed. Sections in the `sections` array are upserted by `id`; sections absent from the array are left alone (deletes go through the dedicated section DELETE endpoint). Reassigning `customer_id` to a customer outside the tenant returns 403. Sending `status: "archived"` is rejected (use `archived_at` to archive).

200.description: The updated quote row. On a rare read-after-write failure, a thin body `{ "id": "<uuid>" }` is returned instead so the client can refetch.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:quotes`

Soft-delete (archive) a quote by setting its status to `archived`. Restricted to the `owner` role. Returns 204 with no body.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:settings`

Return the `company_settings` row for the tenant. Uses an upsert-on-read pattern: if no settings row exists yet, a default row is created and returned. Any tenant member (owner, office, or tech) may read.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:settings`

Partially update the tenant's company settings. All fields are optional; supply only the fields to change. Upserts: if no settings row exists yet, one is created from the supplied fields. Any tenant member (owner, office, or tech) may write. String fields with display content reject control characters and the characters `<`, `>`, and `"` with a 400.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `public anonymous`

Anonymous public endpoint backing the storefront booking widget. Creates a pending booking hold for the tenant via the `create_booking_hold` SECURITY DEFINER RPC. No authentication is required; abuse is gated by the RPC's per-IP and per-tenant rate limits. At least one of `customer_id`, `guest_email`, or `guest_phone` must be supplied so the owner has a way to confirm the request.

201.description: Booking hold created. Only the hold id and expiry are returned; no internal scheduling detail is exposed.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier of the booking hold for which an alternate slot was suggested.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `public anonymous`

Anonymous, single-use endpoint a customer hits from a tokenized email link to accept an owner-suggested alternate booking slot. The single-use token is supplied via the `token` query parameter (no request body). On success the suggestion token is atomically consumed and the agreed slot details are returned. The hold remains in `pending` status — the owner still confirms it separately. Any failure mode (expired, replayed, wrong token, hold not pending, hold not found) returns `410 Gone` with no distinguishing detail to avoid leaking hold state. When the request `Accept` header includes `text/html`, an HTML confirmation page is returned instead of JSON.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Single-use suggestion token (64-character lowercase hex) from the email link.

200.description: Suggestion accepted. Returns the agreed slot details (JSON when the `Accept` header is not `text/html`).

410.description: The link cannot be used: the token is expired, already consumed, invalid, or the hold is no longer pending / not found. No distinguishing detail is returned.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

List all customer tags for the tenant, ordered by name. Tags are a tenant-level shared label library (not a customer sub-resource). This endpoint returns the full collection as a flat array and is not paginated.

200.description: The tenant's tags, ordered by name.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Create a new customer tag. Tag names must be unique per tenant — creating a tag with a name already in use returns 409. If `color` is omitted, the database default `#6b7280` is applied.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:customers`

Retrieve a single customer tag by id.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Update a tag's name and/or color. All fields are optional; omitted fields are left unchanged. Renaming to a name already used by another tag in the tenant returns 409.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:customers`

Permanently delete a tag. This is a hard delete: it cascade-deletes the tag's customer assignments. Deleting a tag that does not exist returns 404.

204.description: The tag was deleted. No content is returned.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:tax_rates`

List the tenant's tax rates, newest first. By default only active (non-archived) rates are returned. Pass `include_archived=1` to instead return only archived (inactive) rates. The response also includes the tenant's `default_tax_rate_id`, which points at the single rate used as the default for new invoices (or null when none is set).

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: When set to `1`, return only archived (inactive) rates instead of active ones. Any other value (or omitting the parameter) returns only active rates.

200.description: The tenant's tax rates and current default rate id.

default_tax_rate_id.description: Id of the tax rate used as the default for new invoices, or null when no default is set.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:tax_rates`

Create a tax rate for the tenant. The rate is entered as a percentage in `rate_percentage` (for example `8.25`) and stored internally as a decimal (`0.0825`). The percentage must be `0 ≤ rate_percentage < 100`. Names must be unique among active rates in the tenant; a collision returns 409. When `is_default` is true, the created rate is also set as the tenant's default for new invoices.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `write:tax_rates`

Update a tax rate's name, rate, description, and/or default flag. All fields are optional. Renaming to a name already used by another active rate returns 409. Setting `is_default` to true promotes this rate to the tenant default (rejected with 409 if the rate is archived); setting it to false clears the tenant default only if this rate is currently the default.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `write:tax_rates`

Archive (soft-delete) a tax rate by setting `is_active` to false. If the rate was the tenant's default, the default is also cleared.

204.description: The tax rate was archived. No content.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `write:settings`

Restore an archived tax rate by setting `is_active` back to true. Active-name uniqueness is enforced by a partial unique index; if restoring would collide with another active rate's name, the request returns 409 (rename the conflicting rate first).

get.description:
**Required scope:** `read:settings`

List the tenant's team members (any member of the tenant may call this). Supports free-text search (`q`, matches display name / name / email) and a result limit.

This endpoint also exposes an owner-only existence probe: calling it with `probe=existing-user` and an `email` returns `{ "exists": <boolean> }` indicating whether an account already exists for that email. The probe is restricted to owners (office and tech roles receive 403) because account existence is itself sensitive; supplying `probe=existing-user` without a valid `email` returns 400.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Free-text search query, matched against the member's display name, name, and email.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of members to return (defaults to 20).

parameters.name: probe
parameters.description: Owner-only existence probe. When set to `existing-user`, the response is `{ "exists": <boolean> }` instead of the member list, and `email` is required.

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: Email to check existence for. Required when `probe=existing-user`.

200.description: The tenant's team members, or — when `probe=existing-user` was supplied — an existence result.

exists.description: Whether an account already exists for the probed email.

post.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Invites a teammate by email and role. A pending invitation is created and an invite email is sent; re-inviting the same email rotates the invitation token. If the email already belongs to a member of this tenant, returns 409 `already_member` and no email is sent. If the email matches an existing Zoop account in another tenant, the invitation is flagged `is_cross_tenant` and a sign-in (rather than sign-up) email is sent.

parameters.name: userId
parameters.description: The user id of the team member.

patch.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Changes a member's role. The last remaining owner of a tenant cannot be demoted (returns 409 `last_owner_protected`). Requesting the role the member already has is an idempotent no-op (`changed: false`). When a member is moved out of `owner`, their admin-tier API keys are revoked as part of the same request.

200.description: The membership after the (possible) role change.

changed.description: False when the requested role matched the current role (no-op).

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Removes a member from the tenant. The last remaining owner cannot be removed (returns 409 `last_owner_protected`). All of the removed member's API keys for this tenant are revoked as part of the same request.

get.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Lists the tenant's pending (not-yet-accepted) team invitations, most recently invited first.

delete.description:
**Required scope:** `admin:settings`

Owner role only (office and tech receive 403). Hard-deletes a pending invitation; the invite link stops working. cadence_rrule.description: iCalendar RRULE string describing the billing cadence. Validated server-side; an invalid value returns 400.

lead_offset_days.description: Days before the cadence date that the invoice is generated.

auto_charge_enabled.description: Request auto-charge. Forced to false server-side unless an active `auto_pay_recurring` consent exists for the customer.

default_tax_rate_id.description: Default tax rate applied to taxable items.

start_date.description: Optional ISO-8601 anchor for the first `next_invoice_at` computation. Defaults to now.

items.description: Plan line items. At least one is required.

PlanUpdate.description: Payload to update a recurring plan template. All fields are optional; only supplied fields are changed. Unknown keys (including `customer_id`) are rejected with 400. `customer_id` and `status` cannot be changed here — status transitions live on dedicated action routes.

cadence_rrule.description: New RRULE. If changed, `next_invoice_at` is recomputed from now; an invalid value returns 400.

payment_method_id.description: New saved payment method, or null to clear.

auto_charge_enabled.description: Enable/disable auto-charge. Enabling is re-verified against an active `auto_pay_recurring` consent and forced to false if none exists.

default_tax_rate_id.description: New default tax rate, or null to clear.

notes.description: New notes, or null to clear.

items.description: Replacement set of plan line items. When present, must contain at least one item; the full item set is replaced.

status.description: Lifecycle status. (The DB additionally uses `archived` to mark soft-deleted quotes, which are excluded from list results.)

accepted_at.description: Set when the customer accepts on the public proposal page.

accepted_by_name.description: Customer-supplied name captured on the acceptance page.

archived_at.description: Null = active. Non-null ISO 8601 timestamp = archived at that instant.

QuoteDetail.description: A quote with its embedded line items, tool inputs, sections, and attachments. The exact column set of the embedded rows is the raw DB row shape; only the confirmed fields are modelled.

quote_line_items.description: Raw line-item rows for the quote.

quote_attachments.description: Attachments, each enriched with a fresh signed URL.

customer_id.description: Optional customer to attach the quote to.

QuoteUpdate.description: Sparse update body — only supplied keys are changed.

customer_id.description: Reassign the quote's customer. Must belong to the same tenant (otherwise 403).

status.description: Lifecycle status. `archived` is not accepted here; use `archived_at` instead.

archived_at.description: Pass an ISO 8601 timestamp to archive, or null to un-archive.

sections.description: Each row is upserted by id. Sections absent from this array are left unchanged.

QuoteLineItemInput.description: A line item supplied in a quote update.

catalog_item_id.description: Optional catalog item this line references.

section_id.description: Null or omitted = quote-level line item. A valid UUID pins the line to that section.

QuoteSectionPatch.description: A section upsert supplied inside a quote update; matched by id.

QuoteLawnToolInput.description: One-shot lawn measurement tool input. On create it attaches a measurement to the new quote; on update it replaces or creates the lawn tool input.

polygon_coords.description: Measured zones. Defaults to an empty array.

summary.description: Optional human summary. If omitted, the server derives one from the area and address.

QuoteAttachment.description: A quote attachment, enriched with a fresh signed URL on read.

section_id.description: Null = pinned at the quote level.

signed_url.description: Fresh signed URL (valid ~1 hour), or null if signing failed for this row.

signed_url_error.description: Present only when signing failed for this attachment.

CompanySettingsBusinessHoursDay.description: Open/close times for a single day of the week.

enabled.description: Whether the business is open on this day.

CompanySettingsBusinessHours.description: Weekly business hours, keyed by day of week.

CompanySettingsAiKnowledgeBase.description: Structured knowledge base used by the AI receptionist.

dispatch_fee.description: Dispatch fee, or null when not set.

services_not_offered.description: Services the business explicitly does not offer.

service_radius_description.description: Free-text description of the service area/radius.

CompanySettings.description: A tenant's company settings row. Responses return the full database row via `select()`, so additional columns may be present beyond those documented here.

brand_color.description: Brand color as a 6-digit hex code.

business_hours_tz.description: IANA time zone used to compute business hours (e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`).

advance_booking_days.description: How many days in advance bookings are allowed.

late_reschedule_cutoff_hours.description: Cutoff (in hours) before which a job may be rescheduled.

booking_widget_enabled.description: Whether the customer booking widget is enabled.

booking_hold_ttl_hours.description: How long (in hours) a booking hold is retained.

booking_default_duration_minutes.description: Default duration (in minutes) for widget bookings.

tech_can_create_event_kinds.description: Calendar event kinds technicians are allowed to create.

late_payment_reminder_days.description: Days after which late-payment reminders are sent.

review_prompt_delay_hours.description: Delay (in hours) before sending a review prompt.

ai_receptionist_enabled.description: Whether the AI receptionist is enabled.

ai_receptionist_intro.description: Intro message used by the AI receptionist.

CompanySettingsUpdate.description: Payload to partially update company settings. All fields are optional; supply only the fields to change. Optional string fields accept an empty string, which is coerced to null. Display string fields (address, tagline) reject control characters and `<`, `>`, `"`.

business_phone.description: Business phone number. Empty string is coerced to null.

business_email.description: Business email address. Empty string is coerced to null.

business_website.description: Business website URL. Empty string is coerced to null.

business_address_line1.description: Street address line 1. Empty string is coerced to null. Rejects control characters and `<`, `>`, `"`.

business_address_city.description: City. Empty string is coerced to null. Rejects control characters and `<`, `>`, `"`.

business_address_state.description: Two-letter state code (exactly 2 characters). Empty string is coerced to null. Rejects control characters and `<`, `>`, `"`.

business_address_zip.description: ZIP/postal code. Empty string is coerced to null. Rejects control characters and `<`, `>`, `"`.

tagline.description: Business tagline. Empty string is coerced to null. Rejects control characters and `<`, `>`, `"`.

brand_color.description: Brand color as a 6-digit hex code.

business_hours_tz.description: IANA time zone for business hours (e.g. `America/Los_Angeles`). Validated against the runtime's supported time zones; invalid zones are rejected with 400.

advance_booking_days.description: How many days in advance bookings are allowed.

late_reschedule_cutoff_hours.description: Cutoff (in hours) before which a job may be rescheduled.

booking_widget_enabled.description: Whether the customer booking widget is enabled.

booking_default_duration_minutes.description: Default duration (in minutes) for widget bookings. Must be one of 30, 45, 60, 90, or 120.

booking_hold_ttl_hours.description: How long (in hours) a booking hold is retained. Must be one of 4, 12, 24, 48, or 72.

tech_can_create_event_kinds.description: Calendar event kinds technicians are allowed to create.

accepted_payment_methods.description: Payment methods the business accepts. Must contain at least one method.

zelle_handle.description: Zelle handle. Empty string is coerced to null.

venmo_handle.description: Venmo handle. Empty string is coerced to null.

cashapp_handle.description: Cash App handle. Empty string is coerced to null.

custom_payment_url.description: Custom payment URL. Empty string is coerced to null.

late_payment_reminder_days.description: Days after which late-payment reminders are sent.

review_prompt_delay_hours.description: Delay (in hours) before sending a review prompt.

review_link_google.description: Google review link. Empty string is coerced to null.

review_link_yelp.description: Yelp review link. Empty string is coerced to null.

review_link_facebook.description: Facebook review link. Empty string is coerced to null.

ai_receptionist_enabled.description: Whether the AI receptionist is enabled.

ai_receptionist_intro.description: Intro message used by the AI receptionist.

StorefrontHoldCreate.description: Guest-supplied payload to create a booking hold from the storefront widget. At least one of `customer_id`, `guest_email`, or `guest_phone` must be present.

customer_id.description: Identifier of a returning customer the owner has on file. If omitted, contact details are required.

service_id.description: Optional catalog item / service the customer is requesting.

note.description: Optional free-text note from the guest.

StorefrontHold.description: Result of a successful booking-hold creation. Intentionally minimal — no internal scheduling detail is exposed.

hold_id.description: Identifier of the created booking hold.

expires_at.description: When the hold expires (ISO 8601 date-time). The widget displays a confirmation countdown from this value.

StorefrontHoldSuggestionAccepted.description: Agreed slot details returned after a customer accepts an owner-suggested alternate slot.

error.description: Error token or, for validation failures, a flattened Zod error object.

errorId.description: Correlation identifier present on internal (500) errors only.

tenant_id.description: The tenant that owns the tag.

name.description: The tag name. Unique per tenant.

color.description: 6-digit hex color with a leading `#`. Defaults to `#6b7280`.

created_by.description: The id of the user that created the tag, or null.

name.description: The tag name. Must be unique within the tenant.

color.description: 6-digit hex color with a leading `#`. If omitted, the default `#6b7280` is applied.

name.description: The new tag name. Must be unique within the tenant.

TaxRate.description: A tenant tax rate. The rate is stored as a decimal in `rate_decimal` (for example `0.0825` for 8.25%). Create/update/restore responses return the full database row via `select()`; the list endpoint returns the explicitly selected fields below. Additional columns may be present on the full-row responses.

name.description: Display name of the tax rate.

rate_decimal.description: The tax rate as a decimal fraction (for example `0.0825` for 8.25%). Stored with numeric(7,6) precision.

is_active.description: Whether the rate is active. Archived rates have this set to false.

TaxRateCreate.description: Payload to create a tax rate. The rate is supplied as a percentage and converted to a decimal for storage.

name.description: Display name. Must be unique among the tenant's active rates.

rate_percentage.description: The tax rate as a percentage (for example `8.25`). Must be `0 ≤ rate_percentage < 100`.

is_default.description: When true, set this rate as the tenant's default for new invoices.

TaxRateUpdate.description: Payload to update a tax rate. All fields are optional; supply only the fields to change.

name.description: New display name. Must not collide with another active rate's name.

rate_percentage.description: New tax rate as a percentage (for example `8.25`). Must be `0 ≤ rate_percentage < 100`.

is_default.description: Set true to promote this rate to the tenant default (rejected with 409 if the rate is archived); set false to clear the tenant default if this rate is currently the default.

description.description: New free-text description, or null to clear it.

TeamMemberRole.description: A team member's role within the tenant.

TeamMember.description: A team member of the tenant, as returned by the list endpoint (joined from the membership and the user account).

display_name.description: Display name, derived from the account's full name / name / email local-part, falling back to 'Unknown user'.

avatar_url.description: Avatar URL, or null when the account has none.

last_sign_in_at.description: When the member last signed in, or null if never.

TeamMembership.description: A membership record returned after a role update.

TeamMemberUpdate.description: Payload to change a member's role.

email.description: Email address to invite. Trimmed and validated as an email.

TeamMemberInvitation.description: An invitation as returned by the invite (POST) and resend endpoints.

expires_at.description: When the invitation expires (7 days from creation/rotation).

is_cross_tenant.description: True when the invited email already has a Zoop account in another tenant (a sign-in email is sent instead of sign-up). Present on the invite (POST) response; absent on the resend response.

TeamMemberPendingInvitation.description: A pending invitation as returned by the list-invitations endpoint.

invited_by_name.description: Display name of the inviter, derived from their account; 'Unknown user' if not resolvable.

BadRequest.description: Invalid request — body failed validation, JSON was malformed, or an unsupported filter was supplied.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid credentials (no token, expired token, revoked key).

Forbidden.description: Authenticated, but the credential lacks the required scope or the caller lacks the required role — or a cross-site request was blocked.

NotFound.description: The requested resource does not exist (or is not visible to this tenant).

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state of the resource (e.g. a duplicate).

ServerError.description: Unexpected server error. The body includes an `errorId` for support correlation.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor taken from a previous response's `next_cursor`.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum number of items to return (default 50, max 100).
